name: 灵羽勇士
evolution: 里奥 → 灵羽勇士 Lv.28 → 圣羽翼王 Lv.40
description: 弱小的家伙为了伙伴却愿意勇敢向前！光羽圣殿的门扉悄然开启，沐浴在圣光之力的启迪中，澎湃的力量汹涌而来。“它的思绪已沉醉在无垠的天际中，这片蓝天便是它魂牵梦绕的地方。”
descriptionEn: The weak little one is willing to bravely step forward for its companions! The gates of the Radiant Feather Temple open quietly; bathed in the enlightenment of holy light, surging power rushes forth. "Its thoughts are drunk in the boundless sky; this blue heaven is the place its soul longs for."

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 疾风刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，若先于敌方攻击，改为3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; 1 hit; if acting before the enemy, becomes 3 hits.

skills.name: 伺机而动
skills.description: 下一次攻击时，技能威力+70。

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if acting before enemy, power +50%.

skills.name: 回旋风暴
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 羽化加速
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+20，迅捷。

skills.name: 羽刃
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：回合结束使敌方紧急脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; respond to status: at end of turn, force enemy to withdraw.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; Swift; respond to status: power becomes 1.5x.
